[SWS_DM_00115] Memory error handling while clearing DTCs
⌈
The Di-
agnostic Server instance shall return a negative response NRC 0x72 (general-
ProgrammingFailure) if it encounters an error in the non-volatile memory while clearing
the DTCs.
⌋
